events.what_it_is: A free immersive bodega-themed pop-up celebrating NYC shop cats, with interactive photo moments and games.
events.what_is_free: Free TEMPTATIONS cat-treat samples plus chances to win Cat Bodega merchandise through games including a claw machine and scratch-offs.
events.caveats: Official sources describe the physical pop-up as free and invite visitors to stop by; no advance RSVP requirement is published. Free samples and prize merchandise are subject to availability.
events.practical_notes: Open Sept. 17-19, noon-6 PM daily at 213 Bowery.

events.what_it_is: Three-day SACHEU beauty pop-up with an immersive installation, product discovery, games, prizes and consultations.
events.what_is_free: The advertised pop-up includes product giveaways while supplies last; some additional gifts require a qualifying recent SACHEU purchase.
events.caveats: RSVP is available but does not guarantee entry; admission is first-come and subject to venue capacity. Giveaways are while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 18-20, 11 AM-5 PM daily at 541 W 25th St. Earlier arrival is advisable for limited giveaways.

events.event_name: The Dewy Day Tour: Yepoda K-Beauty Pop-Up at Sephora Meatpacking
events.what_it_is: Yepoda's K-beauty Sephora pop-up with product trials, giveaways and prize opportunities.
events.what_is_free: No purchase is necessary to attend or receive advertised freebies; exclusive free gifts are while supplies last. Separate gifts-with-purchase require $40+ or $60+ Sephora purchases.
events.caveats: Eventbrite lists free tickets. Free gifts are while supplies last; gifts-with-purchase have separate spend thresholds.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, noon-6 PM, on 13th Street in front of Sephora Meatpacking.

events.address: Colonels Row Building 406A, Governors Island, New York, NY 10004
events.what_it_is: A day of eco-inspired performances, installations, films and interactive workshops centered on environmental justice and eco-arts activism.
events.what_is_free: Festival programming is free and open to the public, including workshops, visual art and performances.
events.caveats: Official and organizer listings say the festival is free/open to the public and reservations are recommended rather than established as mandatory. Governors Island ferry transportation has its own schedules/fares/eligibility rules.
events.practical_notes: Sunday Sept. 20, 11 AM-4 PM. Performances run approximately 12:45-2:45 PM.

events.event_name: Slow Summer at Brooklyn Bridge Park
events.brand: Slow Summer × Brooklyn Bridge Park × Spotify
events.address: Pier 6 Lawn, Brooklyn Bridge Park, Brooklyn, NY
events.what_it_is: A waterfront communal reading party with live music and a conversation with author Josh Silver.
events.what_is_free: The reading-party program is free/open to the public, with giveaways advertised for the first 300 guests.
events.caveats: Free and open to the public; giveaways are limited to the first 300 guests. Outdoor event conditions may affect programming.
events.practical_notes: Sunday Sept. 20. Pier 6 Lawn opens 12:30 PM; programming starts 1 PM and listing runs to 3 PM. Bring a blanket and book.
